description: What a client sends back when the visitor presses a button: the key of the screen it was shown, the outcome of the button pressed and what the visitor entered on that screen. Riddler.Journey.decode_submit/1 gives back the submit for a value this schema validates and findings for any other value. A key beside the three is not refused here, and the decoder drops it. The schema is versioned with the package: it changes only in a release, and that release's changelog names the change.

outcome.description: The outcome of the button the visitor pressed.

responses.description: What the visitor entered on that screen, keyed by question key; an empty object for a screen with no question. What each response has to satisfy is the screen's, checked by Riddler.Screens.validate_screen/3,4, not by this schema.

screen.description: The key of the screen the client was shown.

title: Submit
